Mira P (partnerships): Heads up — ModelForge asked about listing as BYOW (bring-your-own-weights) on the Redwood marketplace and bundling with an SI + HW partner. They want clarity on hosting vs download, licensing, and whether we can include a pre-quantized package for edge SI.
Sam T (bizdev): Nice. Do we have a standard checklist for BYOW? Also need to know if we can require an embargo on public announcement for 30 days.
Jess L (legal): Quick flags: we need the model provenance attestation, a redistribution addendum for downstream rehosting, and explicit grant for hosting in marketplace. BYOW downloads are trickier — depends on model's upstream license. Can they be dual-licensed?
Anika R (eng): From a technical POV, pre-quantized artifacts are fine but must be accompanied by a non-derivative checksum + manifest. Also we need to lock recommended runtime kernels (to avoid performance regressions).
Oliver K (ops): Also: if we allow SI bundles with HW, we need a separate sku for dedicated infra vs hosted. Billing and SLA differ.
Mira P (partnerships): Partner asked whether Redwood can geo-block downloads for EU-only distribution. Legal?
Jess L (legal): Yes if the license allows restrictions; but most permissive OSS licenses (MIT, Apache) don't permit extra distribution constraints. For proprietary or custom licenses, we can enforce geoblocking in our delivery layer, but that has export control implications. We'll need export-team signoff.
Sam T (bizdev): Action items: 1) Ask ModelForge to provide license text + provenance attestation. 2) Get sample artifact and manifest. 3) Decide SKU matrix for: hosted BYOW, downloadable package, SI+HW pre-bundled offering.
partner-bot: @Mira P uploaded: modelforge_attestation.pdf (link)
Mira P (partnerships): I uploaded the attestation. They want the pre-quantized artifact to be redistributable to SIs for on-prem installs under a limited redistribution clause.
Jess L (legal): If redistribution to SIs is allowed, we need: redistribution addendum, source-of-origin clause, and a revocation mechanism if provenance fails. Drafting now — ETA EOD.
Anika R (eng): We'll need to run quantization validation tests and provide an 'integrity check' script. I'll prep a small CI job for the SI handoff.
Oliver K (ops): For the SKU conversation, ops+billing should meet tomorrow. I'll schedule 30m.
Sam T (bizdev): Also coordinate announcement window with marketing — they want 2-week prep. Can we do embargo 30 days post-integration?
Mira P (partnerships): Sounds good. For timelines: legal EOD, eng CI by Wed, ops/billing meeting tomorrow, Sam to confirm marketing.
Jess L (legal): Draft uploaded to /legal-drafts/modelforge-redistribution-v1.docx (link). Please review and flag by noon. :thumbsup:
Sam T (bizdev): @Mira P I'll ping marketing and SI partner.
Mira P (partnerships): Thanks all. Will update thread when we have signed addendum.
